item.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns: Six Topologies and How Each Breaks
item.description: Single-agent systems peaked with bounded tasks and one prompt. Production moved on: organizations now run double-digit agent counts, and a large share of multi-agent pilots die within months of deployment. The killer isn’t the idea — it’s picking the wrong coordination topology, or the right one without knowing its failure modes.
